summary: Well-structured test suite covering all major requirements: retention policies (MaxAgeDays, KeepLatestPerWorkflow, MaxTotalSizeBytes), dry-run vs execute modes, error handling (missing files, malformed JSON, parameter validation), and workflow integration. Unit tests include boundary conditions (artifacts at exact age cutoff) and combined policies. Integration tests cover 3 scenarios (full policy dry-run, age-only execute, nothing-to-delete) with exact output assertions. Workflow tests validate structure, file references, and actionlint compliance. Strengths: clear Pester organization, proper fixture cleanup, helper functions, test independence. Weaknesses: integration test count limited by 3-act-run budget; some edge cases untested (unicode in names, deletion callback errors, very large datasets, malformed artifact metadata). Would catch most regressions in core logic and workflow structure.
